why: A TEMPLATE IS NOT A PRODUCT, the same lesson as the caso.json one floor above. A repository that carries the generator also carries the .tsx files the generator COPIES into the created project — files that are not compiled here, that have no tsconfig here, and that made rebar itself drop from 11 of 11 to 11 of 13 the moment new/ was tracked (measured on 2026-08-31 on a mirror of the repository in os.tmpdir()). The pass side has the modelo.json marker at the template root and the rule leaves the denominator; the fail side is the SAME tree without the marker, and the rule accuses. Whoever deletes the exclusion makes the pass side go red; whoever turns the exclusion into an unconditional bypass makes the fail side go green. `modelo.json` stays Portuguese: it is the literal marker file name the generator writes.
